name: oci-image-to-systemd
displayName: OCI images to native systemd services
description: Run container images as native systemd services with no container runtime: pull OCI images into mount stacks with importctl pull-oci (or pack them into discoverable disk images for older hosts), and render an inventory from docker-swarm-to-systemd into per-host service units with RootMStack=, stack targets and slices, health timers, credentials, mounts, tmpfiles, and install scripts. Use it when the user wants containers under systemd without Docker or Podman, asks about RootMStack=, .mstack directories, importctl, systemd-creds, or wants plain service units for a Swarm or Compose estate.

inventory_dir.title: Inventory directory
inventory_dir.description: Where inventory.json is read from and the rendered tree is written. Defaults to ./.swarm-migration inside the project, matching docker-swarm-to-systemd.
